topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The trees whisper, and the air carries the scent of earth and leaves. Movement near the boundary where the woods thin; the two-leggeds are dragging long lines of wood, fitting them together. They talk in low voices, planning. I watch from the shadows, interest without hurry. The ground beneath my paws is familiar, a place of known paths and scents. The new wood does not scare, but it changes. I will watch, and when the two-leggeds leave, I will explore, learn the new borders. For now, the forest is still mine, vast and unperturbed.
